observations: Photo shows a PS4 console (fat/older style) with a DualShock controller in front
Console and controller are visibly used; no clear signs of damage in this single photo
No visible model/serial label, storage size, or region markings in the photo
No close-up of ports, disc drive, vents, or any power-on screen

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Only one controller is clearly shown in photo 0; condition is not verifiable beyond general appearance.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/anti-tamper evidence shown; photo 0 does not confirm whether it was opened.
No temperature/usage test footage or logs shown; photo 0 cannot confirm overheating.
No port close-ups or functional test shown in photo 0.

claims.claim: original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the receipt or clearly show 'original pads' as separate items.

risks.risk: Seller may be claiming 'Double Pad' but only one controller is shown; missing second controller affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing both controllers side-by-side (front + back) and confirm included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 Fat console + 1 controller (not double pad).

risks.risk: Hacked/custom status is not shown; hacked consoles can be priced differently and may have account/ban or software issues.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the system settings screen (System Information) and the home screen showing installed status, plus a short gameplay/boot video.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst case among comparables that match 'PS4 Fat' but without verified clean/working specifics.

risks.risk: Ports/disc drive/HDMI may be faulty even if it looks fine; overheating and port functionality are not testable from photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short clip showing: power on, HDMI display working, controller pairing, and at least one port test (USB + audio if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Assume not fully verified working; use the lowest comparable that is only 'clean & working' without extra guarantees.

risks.risk: Storage size (e.g., 500GB) and condition of the console internals (thermal paste, fan health) are unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of System Storage/Capacity and a close-up of vents/fan area (or a service sticker if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown storage and normal wear.

proof_requests: Photo showing both controllers (if 'double pad') including front + back, and confirm what accessories are included.
Photo of System Information (storage size/firmware/region) and a short power-on + gameplay/boot video.
Short clip testing HDMI output and at least 2 ports (USB + audio/headset if available).
Photo of the UK receipt (or receipt details) and any included original pads/accessories.
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s a PS4 Fat with one controller, but key pricing drivers (double pad, storage size, hacked/clean status, and verified port/overheating performance) are not provable remotely.
